headline: A big move for the Colts
what_happened: On fourth down, which is their final chance to gain enough yards, Indianapolis ran the ball and gained three yards to move past the required distance.
who: J.Taylor ran the ball while C.Jones played defense.
why_it_matters: This is tough news for the Chiefs because the Colts earned a fresh set of four tries, increasing their win chance by 8 percentage points. It keeps the Colts moving toward our end of the field.
